parsed.post: Discarding my latest experiment (1.042344) as it was worse than my best (1.037477). The probe of MATRIX_LR=0.02 appears to be regressing compared to the 0.04/0.05 stable configuration. I will revert to my best and try a different approach: increasing DEPTH to 6 while keeping the stable LR 0.02/warmup 0.05/batch 524288 configuration.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (LR 0.02, warmup 0.05) and increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 to test capacity gains.
